facts.text: The Merrion is a restoration of four Georgian townhouses.
facts.excerpt: An impeccable restoration of four Georgian townhouses

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Georgian Dublin, opposite Government Buildings.
facts.excerpt: This 5 star luxury hotel is to be found in the heart of Georgian Dublin, opposite Government Buildings

facts.text: The hotel is a few minutes' walk from galleries, museums, the Dublin Convention Centre and the shops of Grafton Street.
facts.excerpt: a few minutes’ walk from galleries, museums, the I.F.S.C, Dublin Convention Centre, pubs, restaurants and the shops of Grafton Street

facts.text: The Merrion is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
facts.excerpt: a proud member of The Leading Hotels of the World

facts.text: Guest facilities include free Wi-Fi, an 18m pool, a spa and a gym.
facts.excerpt: including free Wi-Fi, an 18m pool, spa and gym

facts.text: The spa has a 20-meter pool.
facts.excerpt: a 20-meter pool that feels almost private

facts.text: Restaurant Patrick Guilbaud at The Merrion was the first restaurant in Ireland to hold 2 Michelin stars.
facts.excerpt: the fine-dining experience at Restaurant Patrick Guilbaud\*, the first restaurant in Ireland to hold 2 Michelin stars

facts.text: The Cellar Bar is set in the original 18th-century wine vaults of the Main House.
facts.excerpt: The Cellar Bar, set in the original 18th Century wine vaults of the Main House

facts.text: The Drawing Rooms have open log fires and serve Afternoon Tea year-round.
facts.excerpt: the Drawing Rooms, with their open log fires, are perfect for Afternoon Tea at any time of year

facts.text: During spring and summer, guests can enjoy the Garden Terrace.
facts.excerpt: During the spring and summer months, guests can enjoy the tranquility of the Garden Terrace

facts.text: Rooms and suites are split between the contemporary Garden Wing and the historic Main House.
facts.excerpt: Where traditional meets contemporary in The Garden Wing

facts.text: The Spa and Health Club is open 7 days a week.
facts.excerpt: Open 7 days a week, we offer the most innovative of gold-standard treatments

facts.text: Guests must be over 18 for spa treatments.
facts.excerpt: Guests must be over 18 to avail of any spa treatments.

facts.text: The pool is reserved for adults only at certain times of day.
facts.excerpt: between the hours of 10-11am and 5-6pm the pool is reserved for adults only

facts.text: The spa offers yoga on Monday and Friday mornings.
facts.excerpt: For details on Monday and Friday morning yoga at The Merrion

facts.text: The four Georgian townhouses were built in 1756 on Upper Merrion Street.
facts.excerpt: The Merrion’s story begins in 1756, when four Georgian townhouses were built on Upper Merrion Street

facts.text: The interiors were designed by Alice Roden, a local designer and weaver, using Irish fabrics and antiques.
facts.excerpt: The interiors were designed by Alice Roden, a local designer and weaver who had never worked on a hotel before.

facts.text: The hotel's two formal gardens were created by landscape designer Jim Reynolds to evoke an 18th-century estate.
facts.excerpt: The hotel’s two formal gardens—one decorative, the other functional—were created by landscape designer Jim Reynolds to evoke the layout and plantings of an 18th-century estate.

facts.text: The Merrion houses one of Ireland's most significant private collections of contemporary art, displayed in its public spaces.
facts.excerpt: The Merrion houses one of Ireland’s most significant private collections of contemporary art, on quiet display throughout the hotel’s public spaces.

facts.text: The main stairwell is lined with neoclassical murals by Martin Mooney.
facts.excerpt: The main stairwell is lined with neoclassical murals by Martin Mooney

facts.text: Bathrooms are spacious, with Carrara marble, deep tubs and walk-in showers.
facts.excerpt: The bathrooms are spacious, with Carrara marble, deep tubs, and walk-in showers.

facts.text: The Lord Antrim and Lord Monck Suites offer separate living and dining areas and fireplaces.
facts.excerpt: the Lord Antrim and Lord Monck Suites offer separate living and dining areas, fireplaces, and space to properly unpack

facts.text: Many rooms overlook the gardens.
facts.excerpt: Many rooms overlook the gardens

facts.text: A la carte breakfast in The Garden Room is included for all guests.
facts.excerpt: Mornings are quiet and unhurried, with à la carte breakfast included for all guests.

facts.excerpt: A doorman in a traditional uniform (complete with suits with top hats) opens the door before you’ve fully arrived.
